name: HD Ticket - CRM Lookup & Routing
script: # ======================================================== # 1️⃣ + 2️⃣ العمليات التي تتم عند إنشاء التذكرة لأول مرة # ======================================================== if doc.is_new(): sender_email = doc.get("raised_by") or doc.get("sender") or doc.get("email_id") if sender_email: sender_email = str(sender_email).strip().lower() contact_name = '' contact_pcc = '' # 1. البحث مباشرة في الجدول الرئيسي Sabre Agency agency_row = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, agency_name, iata, pcc, email, phone FROM `tabSabre Agency` WHERE lower(email) = %s LIMIT 1 """, (sender_email,)) if not agency_row: # 2. لو مفيش نتيجة، دوّر في الـ child (Sabre Agency Contact) match = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT c.parent, c.contact_name, c.pcc FROM `tabSabre Agency Contact` c WHERE lower(c.email) = %s LIMIT 1 """, (sender_email,)) if match: contact_name = match[0][1] or '' contact_pcc = match[0][2] or '' agency_row = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT name, agency_name, iata, pcc, email, phone FROM `tabSabre Agency` WHERE name = %s """, (match[0][0],)) else: # 3. إذا وجدنا الوكالة الرئيسية، نبحث عن contact_name من الـ child table contact_match = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT contact_name, pcc FROM `tabSabre Agency Contact` WHERE lower(email) = %s AND parent = %s LIMIT 1 """, (sender_email, agency_row[0][0])) if contact_match: contact_name = contact_match[0][0] or '' if contact_match[0][1]: contact_pcc = contact_match[0][1] # 4. إسناد البيانات للحقول القياسية وحقول الواجهة (custom_) if agency_row: row = agency_row[0] pcc_val = contact_pcc or row[3] or '' # الحقول القياسية doc.pcc = pcc_val doc.agency_name = row[1] or '' doc.custom_agent_contact = sender_email # حقول الواجهة Custom Fields doc.custom_agency = row[0] doc.custom_contact_name = contact_name doc.custom_agency_iata = row[2] or '' doc.custom_agency_pcc = pcc_val doc.custom_agency_email = row[4] or sender_email doc.custom_agency_phone = row[5] or '' else: doc.pcc = "Unknown" doc.agency_name = f"Unknown - {sender_email}" doc.custom_agent_contact = sender_email # ─── 2. نظام التوجيه التلقائي والتصنيف ─── # تعيين الفريق الافتراضي دائماً لـ L1 Associate Team ليتولى نظام الـ Round Robin التوزيع if not doc.agent_group: doc.agent_group = "L1 Associate Team" if doc.get("ticket_type") != "Phone Call": subject_text = str(doc.get("subject") or "").lower() csm_keywords = [ "migration", "data migration", "data transfer", "نقل بيانات", "ترحيل بيانات", "تحويل بيانات", "complaint", "شكوى", "delay", "تأخير", "follow up", "متابعة", "onboarding", "implementation", "training", "تدريب", "setup assistance", "customer success" ] finance_keywords = [ "invoice", "billing", "payment", "refund", "subscription", "renewal", "charge", "overdue", "transaction", "credit", "debit", "فاتورة", "دفع", "اشتراك", "تجديد", "استرداد", "مطالبة مالية", "حسابات", "مالية" ] product_keywords = [ "bug", "error", "patch", "feature request", "enhancement", "customization", "development", "integration", "api", "performance", "optimization", "ui", "ux", "خطأ برمجي", "مشكلة بالنظام", "تعديل", "تطوير", "برمجة", "ميزة جديدة", "تكامل" ] it_keywords = [ "server", "network", "internet", "printer", "camera", "firewall", "telephony", "3cx", "vpn", "email issue", "wifi", "router", "login", "password", "slow", "crash", "down", "not working", "سيرفر", "شبكة", "انترنت", "طابعة", "كاميرا", "جدار حماية", "سنترال", "فايرول", "راوتر", "واي فاي", "إيميل لا يعمل" ] csm_score = 0 for k in csm_keywords: if k in subject_text: csm_score += 1 finance_score = 0 for k in finance_keywords: if k in subject_text: finance_score += 1 product_score = 0 for k in product_keywords: if k in subject_text: product_score += 1 it_score = 0 for k in it_keywords: if k in subject_text: it_score += 1 scores = { "CSM": csm_score, "Finance": finance_score, "Product": product_score, "IT": it_score } highest_score = max(scores.values()) winner = None if highest_score > 0: for team in ["CSM", "Finance", "Product", "IT"]: if scores[team] == highest_score: winner = team break # تحديد نوع التذكرة تلقائياً مع الإبقاء على الفريق L1 Associate Team if winner == "CSM": doc.ticket_type = "General Inquiry" elif winner == "Finance": doc.ticket_type = "Billing Issue" elif winner in ["Product", "IT"]: doc.ticket_type = "Technical Issue" else: doc.ticket_type = "General Inquiry" # ======================================================== # 3️⃣ + 4️⃣ الأقفال الأمنية (Resolved / Closed / Escalated) # ======================================================== current_status = str(doc.get("status") or "").lower() current_workflow = str(doc.get("workflow_state") or "").lower() if current_status in ["resolved", "closed"] or current_workflow in ["resolved", "closed"]: if not doc.get("custom_subissue"): frappe.throw( title="تنبيه جودة البيانات", msg="عذراً! يجب تغذية حقل المشكلة الفرعية (Sub-Issue) أولاً قبل تحويل المستند إلى حالة الحل أو الإغلاق." ) if current_workflow == "escalated": task_exists = frappe.db.exists("Task", { "custom_ticket": doc.name, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"] }) if not task_exists: frappe.throw( title="إجراء نظام صارم", msg="عذراً! لا يمكن تصعيد التذكرة أو تحويلها للفريق الفني دون إنشاء مهمة (Task) مرتبطة بها أولاً." )
